instruction: Create one Part Design body. Create a rectangular base plate sized 60 mm along global X, 24 mm along global Y, and 6 mm along global Z, with lower-back-left corner at the origin so it spans X = 0 to 60, Y = 0 to 24, and Z = 0 to 6. A lug means a raised rectangular protrusion added on top of the base. Add one rectangular lug sized 8 mm along X, 6 mm along Y, and 6 mm along Z, located in the front-left quadrant on the top face, spanning X = 8 to 16, Y = 4 to 10, and Z = 6 to 12. Use a Part Design Multi-Transform on that lug: first mirror it across the base centerline plane Y = 12 to create a matching rear lug, then linearly pattern the pair along global X with 2 total positions spaced 36 mm apart. The final top pattern should contain four lugs with X ranges 8..16 and 44..52, and Y ranges 4..10 and 14..20. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
